family: Payment Card and Cart Troubleshooting Policy
source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: The agent is permitted to complete the purchase on the customer's behalf via Make Purchase only after collecting the credit card number, expiration date, and the brand/item phrase.
If the customer suspects an expired card, the agent is required to enter 'troubleshoot' via Enter Details rather than escalating.
Card and cart troubleshooting is required to be attempted via Try Again or Log Out/In prior to any account or purchase action is taken.
